"
                UPDATE pengajuan_judul pj
                JOIN pengguna p ON pj.id_mahasiswa = p.id
                JOIN mahasiswa m ON m.pengguna_id = p.id
                SET 
                    pj.semester_saat_pengajuan = (
                        (CASE 
                            WHEN MONTH(pj.created_at) >= 9 THEN YEAR(pj.created_at)
                            ELSE YEAR(pj.created_at) - 1
                        END - (2000 + CAST(LEFT(m.nim, 2) AS UNSIGNED))) * 2 
                        + CASE 
                            WHEN MONTH(pj.created_at) >= 9 OR MONTH(pj.created_at) <= 2 THEN 1 
                            ELSE 2 
                        END
                    ),
                    pj.periode_akademik_saat_pengajuan = CONCAT(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN MONTH(pj.created_at) >= 9 OR MONTH(pj.created_at) <= 2 THEN 'Ganjil '
                            ELSE 'Genap '
                        END,
                        CASE 
                            WHEN MONTH(pj.created_at) >= 9 THEN YEAR(pj.created_at)
                            ELSE YEAR(pj.created_at) - 1
                        END,
                        '/',
                        CASE 
                            WHEN MONTH(pj.created_at) >= 9 THEN YEAR(pj.created_at) + 1
                            ELSE YEAR(pj.created_at)
                        END
                    )
                WHERE pj.semester_saat_pengajuan IS NULL
                AND pj.deleted_at IS NULL
            "
"ALTER TABLE pengajuan_judul MODIFY COLUMN status ENUM('diajukan', 'direvisi', 'disetujui', 'dibatalkan') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'diajukan'"
"ALTER TABLE berita_acara MODIFY status_revisi VARCHAR(50) NULL"
